description: This file defines the XPen class, a core drawing object used to draw lines and curves in the PDFsharp library. It includes multiple constructors, properties for styling (color, width, dash pattern, line join, line cap, etc.), cloning functionality, and platform-specific code for GDI+ and WPF rendering.

classes.name: XPen
classes.description: A sealed class representing a pen used for drawing lines, curves, and strokes in the PDFsharp library. It supports multiple drawable platforms via conditional compilation, and includes properties for styling and methods for cloning and realization.

methods.name: XPen
methods.description: Constructors for initializing an XPen instance with color, width, and other attributes.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this XPen instance.
